# Three Monkeys Restaurant

Southern Thai dining in a rainforest setting inside Hanuman World in Phuket.

## Contact and location
- Website: https://threemonkeysphuket.com
- Reservations: https://threemonkeysphuket.com/booking
- Menu: https://threemonkeysphuket.com/menu
- Phone and WhatsApp: +66 98-010-8838
- Email: enjoy@threemonkeysphuket.com
- Address: 105 Moo 4, Muang Chao Fa Road, Wichit, Mueang Phuket, Phuket 83000, Thailand
- Website-listed hours: daily 10:00 AM–1:00 AM; last orders at midnight.
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/threemonkeysrestaurant
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/threemonkeysrestaurant/

## Reservations
Choose a dining zone, date, available time and guest count using the booking page.
Monkey Dome seats up to 4 guests per table; Monkey Nest seats up to 6.
Deposits for these two zones are charged per table. Other zones may charge per person.
Current prices, availability and terms are displayed during booking; admin overrides can change them.
Special packages, optional extras and private transfers require advance booking.

## Dining
The menu includes Southern Thai dishes, seafood, curries and vegetarian dishes.
Tell the restaurant about allergies and dietary requirements before booking.
See the menu for current dishes and prices and contact the restaurant for suitability.
